prompt:

Asset type: kubcode editorial article cover, first in a cohesive three-image series.

A gently curving sequence of translucent empty film frames emerges from a small dark unmarked terminal-like slab, with no screen content or interface.
Style/medium: refined soft 3D with layered frosted glass and satin paper materials, calm editorial illustration, clean deliberate geometry.
Scene/backdrop: seamless deep purple to near-black background, #100e15 and #2c1549, subtle ground shadow.
Composition/framing: wide landscape 16:9; all subjects grouped in the right two-thirds, left third quiet dark negative space. Keep the complete motif within the central 80% of image height and away from edges so a slightly shorter wide crop retains everything.
Lighting/mood: broad soft directional light from upper left, gentle lavender glow, restrained warm highlight, considered and calm.
Color palette: deep purple and near-black, lavender #bb98ff and #d1b9ff, consistent monochromatic purple series.
Constraints: no text, letters, numbers, readable code, logos, brands, watermark, UI chrome, screenshots, realistic people, faces, or named artist imitation. The slab is a simple physical abstract object without UI. No harsh artifacts. Render a polished landscape illustration.
